Hi Laura —

Thanks again for the productive discovery last week. Per our conversation, we want to lock a set of calendar holds for the executive workshop in late November so your team can plan travel and internal approvals. Proposed approach:

- Block 3 half-days for the on-site workshop (agenda attached as draft v3).
- Reserve a single-day optional deep-dive for platform/ops follow-up (virtual).
- Provide hotel block details + invite letters for visas once dates final.

Can you confirm which of these options works for SummitHealth? To make scheduling easy across teams in PST/EST/IST, here are three candidate windows (local times shown for your convenience):

A) Nov 16–18 (Mon–Wed) — daily 09:00–12:30 PT / 12:00–15:30 ET / 22:30–01:00 IST
B) Nov 23–25 (Mon–Wed) — daily 10:00–13:30 PT / 13:00–16:30 ET / 23:30–02:00 IST
C) Nov 30–Dec 2 (Mon–Wed) — daily 08:30–12:00 PT / 11:30–15:00 ET / 20:00–00:30 IST

If you prefer a hybrid pattern (mix of in-person core days + virtual deep-dive), we can mark the virtual session as optional for remote attendees. Once you confirm a window, we will:

1) Create calendar holds for Redwood + SummitHealth core attendees and shared presenters.
2) Share hotel block links and issue visa invite letters for any international travelers.
3) Confirm AV/BYO equipment and on-site contact (we recommend a single AV lead from SummitHealth).

Attachment: agenda-draft-v3.pdf (outline, goals, and staffing asks).

Best,
